title: 第7章 逃离国都第8章 敕妖咒
lines: 王右思脸色难看，怒吼起来。
碾压之局，却几次三番被林辰化解，而此刻林辰更是站在了城门口！
他这个守城大将早已颜面尽失！
他绝不允许再有意外，不论如何，他都必须亲手斩杀林辰！
王右思再度斩出一剑，巨大剑芒凝实无比，空气都微微扭曲，好像要被震散一般！
这一剑正对着林辰，正对着城门！
除非林辰放弃逃跑，否则没有避开的可能性！
而一旦避了，金甲守卫合围而至，林辰插翅难飞！
王右思嘶吼，不断将剑意灌入这一剑。
只是突然，他体内的剑意竟然出现了刹那的不稳，这一剑原本要升华而出的最强力量，竟未能达到。
王右思一怔，却也不在意，毕竟他还未走到凝意境巅峰，剑意稍微不稳也是正常。
而且这些许差距改变不了什么。
林辰在门洞中有限的空间内，奋力做出闪避，避免正对那锋芒，但即便是边缘的杀伤，依旧可以让他瞬间死亡！
林辰咆哮，不计后果的爆发，丹田中那道剑影大放光芒，所有力量全部投入到天钨之中！
霸罡境的武者再如何疯狂提升力量，又怎么可能抵挡凝意境的全力一击？
他看到了林辰吐血倒飞，浑身血肉被长剑切割，血水飞溅，已经如同一个血人一般！
却是盔甲砸在地上的声音。
那城门的门洞之中，竟有一道人影，浑身是血，挣扎着站了起来，掀开了身上砸落的盔甲等。
content_en:
"You think you can escape?!"
Wang Yousi looked ugly and roared angrily.
The crushing situation was resolved by Lin Chen several times, and now Lin Chen was standing at the gate of the city!
He, the general who defended the city, had already lost all face!
He will never allow any more accidents. No matter what, he must kill Lin Chen with his own hands!
The sword intention enters the shaking sword!
Wang Yousi struck out with his sword again. The huge sword light was so solid that the air was slightly distorted, as if it was about to be shaken away!
This sword is facing Lin Chen, facing the city gate!
Unless Lin Chen gives up escaping, there is no possibility of avoiding it!
But once he escaped, the golden-armored guards surrounded him, making it difficult for Lin Chen to fly!
"Still dead?!"
Wang Yousi roared, constantly pouring sword intent into this sword.
But suddenly, the sword intention in his body became unstable for a moment, and the strongest power that the sword was supposed to sublimate failed to reach.
Wang Yousi was startled, but he didn't care. After all, he had not yet reached the peak of the Ningyi realm, and it was normal for his sword to be slightly unstable.
And these slight differences don't change anything.
Lin Chen will definitely die!
Lin Chen struggled to dodge in the limited space in the doorway to avoid facing the sharp edge, but even the edge damage could still kill him instantly!
There is no choice.
Don't want to die.
Can't die!
Nine Heavens God-killing Technique!
Open it for me!
Lin Chen roared, recklessly erupting, the sword shadow in his dantian shined brightly, and all his power was put into the tungsten!
The sky turns into a tungsten black dragon.
Rush towards Wang Yousi's sword!
sucker Punch!
No matter how the warriors in the Ba Gang Realm crazily increase their strength, how can they withstand the full blow of Ning Yi Jing?
If you can't avoid it, you will die!
Wang Yousi sneered.
He saw Lin Chen vomiting blood and flying backwards, his flesh and blood being cut by the sword, blood and water splashing, already like a bloody man!
it's over.
"The treasonous traitors shall be punished!"
Wang Yousi shouted loudly.
The bell clangs.
But it was the sound of armor hitting the ground.
Wang Yousi's face froze.
In the doorway of the city gate, there was a figure, covered in blood, struggling to stand up, and lifting off the armor that had been smashed on his body.
title_en: Chapter 7 Escape from the Capital Chapter 8 The Demonic Curse
